newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to formally retain Rubin as Treasury chief.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to formally retain Rubin as Treasury chief.

text.p: President Clinton is set to retain Robert Rubin as Treasury Secretary at a news conference today at 2 p.m. (1900 GMT), administration sources said on Friday.

The decision has been widely expected. Rubin himself said as much on Sunday, when he told NBC television's "Meet the Press" program to expect "a relatively familiar face at Treasury" in Clinton's second term.
